svg.text: Diagram 1 — BasinWatch: the complete Java system
Verified runtime architecture. Every box is a real class in the repository.
Swing window · mouse, keyboard, zone selector
SWING USER INTERFACE — the event-dispatch thread (EDT)
start() · pause() · step() · dispatch() · injectStorm() · save() · load() · exportReport()
DOMAIN / ENGINE LAYER — BasinEngine owns lifecycle
Immutable snapshots published to the EDT
thread states · queue depth · waiting consumers / producers · archive backlog
SENSOR INPUT / I-O PATH — character streams and a pipe
ACCEPTED EVENTS — persisted on separate paths
